text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um!
I'm here to pick up
the new release I reserved! Um, the one on sale today—

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rob Roy-chan.
About that... I'm so sorry, dear.

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Lady
text_block_list.text:
The delivery truck is running late,
so it looks like the stock won't arrive until tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I-I'm fine!
I can totally wait, so... I can totally wait...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to buy the new release she had been anticipating, Zenno Rob Roy stood dejected in front of the bookstore...
